source_summary: Winter river scene with a covered fishing boat beneath a twisted leafless tree, an angler in straw rain gear, snowy foreground shrubs and reeds, distant low grasses, and pervasive falling snow over gray-brown wash. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: twisted_winter_tree_trunk
motifs.description: Isolate the gnarled lower and middle trunk of the leafless tree rising from the foreground bank, including exposed roots, knots, scars, and snow clinging to bark ridges; exclude the boat, figure, foliage bank, and inscriptions.
must_preserve: dark broken contour lines defining the twisting trunk
pale tan and gray bark washes
black knot holes and scar marks
white snow accents along bark edges
root-like extensions crossing toward the boat

motifs.name: bare_tree_crown
motifs.description: Isolate the upper network of leafless winter branches extending from the central trunk toward the left and right, with forked twigs and snow highlights; exclude calligraphy, seals, and background speckles not attached to the branches.
must_preserve: thin angular branch linework
dark ink joints and forked twig tips
pale gray dry-brush bark texture
small white snow touches on branch tops
asymmetrical sweeping branch silhouette

motifs.name: covered_fishing_boat
motifs.description: Isolate the wooden fishing boat with curved hull, pointed stern, woven cabin cover, deck planks, and rear canopy structure; exclude the angler figure, tree trunk, foreground shrubs, and fishing line where possible.
must_preserve: curved ink outline of the hull
tan wood wash and subtle plank divisions
arched woven cabin roof with grid hatching
triangular raised stern and side rails
small dark deck fastenings and interior seams

motifs.name: angler_in_straw_cape
motifs.description: Isolate the seated angler inside the boat, including broad straw hat, visible face, straw rain cape, blue robe, folded lower garment, and long fishing line extending to the right.
must_preserve: round straw hat with concentric rim lines
small facial features and beard linework
radiating straw cape strokes
blue robe color accent
thin fishing line arcing outward to the right

motifs.name: foreground_autumn_shrub_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the snowy riverbank shrub mass at lower left with ochre-brown leaves, dark stems, rocks, and snow patches around the tree base; exclude the main tree trunk and boat as much as possible.
must_preserve: clustered fan-like ochre leaves
black twig and branch linework
white snow caps on rocks and leaf clusters
jagged ink rock outlines
layered overlapping foliage at the bank edge

motifs.name: central_snowy_reed_clump
motifs.description: Isolate the small clump of dark reeds and grasses beneath the boat near the lower center, with snow-dusted tips and crossing blade strokes; exclude hull, tree roots, and nearby foliage.
must_preserve: thin black reed blades
crosshatched grass strokes
white snow touches along reed tops
irregular low mound silhouette
dry-brush ink variation

motifs.name: distant_right_snowy_grass_mound
motifs.description: Isolate the low distant mound of grasses at the lower right, with sparse arcing blades and white snow along the crest; exclude surrounding empty water wash and any border area.
must_preserve: delicate arcing grass blades
dark ink crossings at the base
soft gray-brown ground wash
white snow highlights on upper ridges
low flattened distant-bank shape

motifs.name: snow_filled_river_mist
motifs.description: Isolate the atmospheric field of falling snow over muted gray-brown river mist and open water, including faint horizontal wash traces and scattered white flakes; exclude all calligraphy, seals, boat, figure, tree, shrubs, reeds, and border.
must_preserve: uneven white snow speckles of varied sizes
soft gray-brown wash transitions
subtle horizontal water-ripple traces
open negative space around the central scene
diffuse misty edges without hard outlines

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
